tasks.label: build: auto (debug)
args: set -euo pipefail; src="${file}"; ext="${fileExtname}"; relDir="${relativeFileDirname}"; outDir="${workspaceFolder}/build/${relativeFileDirname}"; out="${workspaceFolder}/build/${relativeFileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; mkdir -p "$outDir"; if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then CC=clang; CXX=clang++; else CC=gcc; CXX=g++; fi; case "$ext" in .c) "$CC" -std=c17 -g -O0 -Wall -Wextra "$src" -o "$out" ;; .cc|.cpp|.cxx|.C) "$CXX" -std=c++20 -g -O0 -Wall -Wextra "$src" -o "$out" ;; *) echo "Unsupported extension: $ext (only .c .cc .cpp .cxx .C)" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
